targets.speaker: ALEX
targets.target: If an AI agent can touch more tools, does that make it more useful or more dangerous?

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: The simple version is this: every tool, server, connector, and permission an agent can touch becomes a new place for risk.

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: The scary part is not the average result. It is the person, patient, team, or company living inside the exception.

targets.speaker: RUFUS
targets.target: Lovely. We have automated the decision and preserved the blame. Very efficient, in the bleakest possible sense.

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: Think of it like giving an intern keys to every room in the building and then acting surprised when a door opens.

targets.speaker: ALEX
targets.target: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.

targets.speaker: RUFUS
targets.target: The question for tomorrow is not whether agent surface area sounds clever. It is who gets caught when it becomes real.
